children: SCHIPHOL-RIJK (dpa-AFX) - Airbus SE (AIR.PA) said it delivered 72 aircraft in September 2026, broadly flat compared with 73 aircraft in the year-ago period.
Year-to-date deliveries through September totaled 547 aircraft, up 8% from the same period a year ago.
The plane maker recorded 17 gross orders during September.
In Paris, Airbus shares closed down 0.10% at €187.26 on Thursday.
